Tianne Hall
3:14 PM (0 minutes ago)
to me

Hi Bethany!

Please excuse my late reply as I just landed from AmSpa this past week. I thoroughly enjoyed our conversation and felt we aligned on many important aspects of the industry. I spoke with my husband about your proposal and he let me know that he had just set up a direct partnership with another consulting company in exchange for some equity.

We would however love to be considered as a buyer you send your clients to and we are happy to discuss a referral fee that has value.

Let me know your thoughts.

Subject: Re: Great Connecting + Next Steps

Hi Tianne,

Welcome back, I can only imagine how exciting AmSpa was this year. I was so bummed to miss it, I definitely would have been there if I wasn’t this close to surgery.

I really enjoyed our conversation as well and completely agree, it felt like we were very aligned in how we both approach this space. I appreciate you sharing the update on the partnership, that makes total sense.

Eric and I would still absolutely love to connect and explore how we can work together as a referral partner. We are always looking to place our clients with the right buyers, especially groups that care about maintaining the integrity of the practice, so I think there is a really strong opportunity here.

Would love to set up a time for the four of us to connect and talk through what that could look like and how we can make it valuable on both sides.

Looking forward to it,
Bethany
